Hearing such an answer, Pan Jie was very satisfied, and then Pan Jie went back with his two followers. "Grandpa, in my heart you are my grandfather, forever!" The words were unusually heavy, but they were the truest reflection of Xiao Wuxie's heart at this time. "Master has almost completed the investigation of the intelligence of the scout operation, and has returned to the organization to report. It won't be long before he comes back to protect you. For now. Let me help you." Han Ling said this. Wang Shu wanted to laugh inexplicably when he saw Chuan Xing's shy look. A man in his thirties or forties was embarrassed when he said such a thing. Su Qi relied on the speed bonus of Shadow Step to nimbly fight with the Winged Tiger several times, causing The damage was good, but because of the damaged attributes, the powerful Winged Tiger was still not seriously injured. Walking into the back hall, I saw hundreds of futons in the field, and many people were sitting on them, listening carefully to Lu Yun's speech. The wind was roaring in their ears. The positive wind brings a biting chill to people, making them fall into the Nine Nether Hells, and their blood seems to freeze. After Ya Yaluo catches Ling Xiao, he discovers that Ling Xiao is practicing the old man's technique. The old man is Ya Yaluo's mortal enemy. The great light faith often opposes Ya Yaluo. The Zhongliu sect is also a disciple from the Zhuyuan period, whose surname is Yuan Mingzhenghao. The Zhongliu sect is good at talismans. It can be seen from the fact that Zhongliu just drew talismans in the air to resist thunder. The Liu sect is very proficient in talismans and spells. "Unfortunately, I have wandered countless star fields so far and have never encountered a third-level enlightenment tree. It is really a pity that I can't show off my skills!" Lu Ye moved his eyes to the enlightenment tree.
